layout: float32 little-endian, row-major, no header: W1[48][64], b1[48], W2[48][48], b2[48], W3[6][48], b3[6] (5766 floats, 23064 bytes); tanh on every layer (crucible think())
note: TWO hidden layers of 48 (h1, h2). Keys: w1 (h1 x in), b1, w2 (h2 x h1), b2, w3 (out x h2), b3. The brief's single-layer 'w2 (NOUT x H)' is w3 here; significance.hidden_out is h2->out, and significance.h1_h2 is added.

outputs.name: turn correction (added to rules' turn, x pi rad)
fire correction (added to rules' fire; fires if sum>0)
gate / confidence (open if >0, else rules exactly)

significance.formula: s = |w| x mean|activation of the source unit| over the sample; in->h1 uses the recorded inputs, h1->h2 and h2->out use M0049's own h1/h2 recomputed on those inputs
significance.row_format: [source index, destination index, signed weight, significance]

act_source: recorded inputs of 723 steps: archive/montages/0011/mind.json (409 steps; boburner-cuda M0041, M0042, M0043, M0044, M0045 and g137300, duels of montage 11, 15 Nov 10:07) and archive/montages/0010/mind.json (314 steps; boburner-cuda M0036-M0040, 14 Nov). They are the inputs those nets saw in world duels (clips around pillbox fights, kills and a loss), not M0049's own play and not the gauntlet's mazes; M0049's hidden and output activations are recomputed from its weights on them. The memory inputs 62/63 are the recorded nets' own memory.

forward_check.what: the format and forward pass (tanh, row-major) checked layer by layer against montage 11's recorded h1, h2, y for M0041..M0045 run on their own recorded inputs (the record keeps 2 decimals)
forward_check.h1_from_x: 98.7-99.5% of h1 values within 0.05 of the record, sign agreement >= 99.9% (5 nets, 324 steps)
forward_check.note: chained end to end from the 2-decimal inputs, a few near-zero units flip and the maximum error reaches 1.9; that is the record's rounding, not the format

sensor_matrix.rows: ray r = 0..11 at hull heading + 30*r degrees

hybrid.rule: open = y[3] > 0; turn,speed,fire = clip(rules + y[0..2], -1, 1) if open else rules; memory[m] = y[4+m] every step (crucible.cu decide())
hybrid.gate_neuron: h2[3] (w3[3][3] = +48.77; its sign matches the gate on 98.5% of the sample)

units.live_means: sign on each side on at least 5% of the 723 steps

group_ablation.how: the group's inputs held at their sample means; mean abs change of the net's outputs, and of the action the tank takes after the gate
